Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
WHEN a pending points transaction is 24 hours old and the purchase was not returned, the loyalty service shall post the points to the member's balance.
Rationale: The 24-hour return window protects against points on returned goods.

Text: WHEN the member opens the balance screen, the customer mobile app shall display the posted points balance.
Rationale: Members check their balance after paying.

Text: WHEN a member with at least 500 posted points requests a voucher in the customer mobile app, the loyalty service shall issue a voucher worth SGD 1 per 100 points redeemed.
Rationale: Redemption rule from the programme terms.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service issues a voucher, it shall deduct the redeemed points from the member's posted balance.
Rationale: Keeps the balance consistent with issued vouchers.

Text: WHEN the POS sends a voucher validation request, the loyalty service shall return the voucher status to the POS.
Rationale: The POS applies the discount only for valid vouchers.

Text: The loyalty service shall answer voucher validation requests fast enough for checkout.
The customer mobile app shall show the member's recent vouchers.
Rationale: Members want to find their vouchers at the till.
